text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The racers up front set a brutally high
pace. There was seemingly little hope of
catching up, but then... Narita Brian
overtook them all
and seized the win!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Not only was it a Satsuki Sho record, she
set a new top time for the
2,000-meter
Nakayama track!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What a heart-pounding race! The thunder
of applause from the stands
won't stop!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wha... What was that explosion on the
final stretch?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
This is a G1 race, but those other racers
looked like toddlers! I had no
idea Narita
Brian was so good!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She gets a landslide three-length lead,
with a course record to boot. And yet she
stands there, looking disappointed the
race ended so
soon.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Brian... Even on the track,
you're still
my greedy little sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Classics are prestigious races as it is—and that win was phenomenal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It cemented Narita Brian's reputation:
she's
the best racer of the
generation.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoo, Brian's outta this world... Every
single lap is a new personal
best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I know she ran an amazing race in the
Satsuki Sho, but who would've
thought she
had this much more potential?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Look at that—even the onlookers are
standing there dumbstruck.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
She shoots past our expectations every
run. I've had to revamp her
training routine
over and over.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Nice going, Brian. You're getting
comfortable with that running style.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Low center of gravity, right? I heard you
two created it together when
you scouted
her.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I gave some advice, but Brian's the one
who made it work. I was
blown away the
first time I saw it.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I gave some advice, but Brian's the one
who made it work. I was
blown away the
first time I saw it.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
All right,
let's finish off with one more lap.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just one? Then I'll take it seriously. Get
that stopwatch ready.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Say what? You weren't serious this whole
time?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...You may need to rework that training
routine again.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Looks like it...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Brian! Do you have time for a
quick question?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what the heck?! We're in the
middle of training here!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry to interrupt,
but I couldn't get
a hold of Narita Brian
anywhere else. This
is the only chance I've got!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If it means that much to you...
I've got you
covered! What's your
question?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'll let you handle it. I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Aaah, wait! Just one thing!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You ran a beautiful race at the Satsuki
Sho, but what's next for you?
Will you try
to become the fifth ever Triple Crown
champion?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...They're all just stepping stones.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Stepping stones? H-hey, what exactly do
you mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Exactly as she said.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Winning the Triple Crown is not enough to
satisfy her hunger.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I thought I'd find you here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's a flood of reporters down at the
training grounds, trying to
find you for an
interview.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey Sis...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
At the Satsuki Sho... the leaders set a
breakneck pace from the start.
Usually,
everyone would be worn out by the final
straight.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Nevertheless, you met the challenge, and
when everyone else ran out
of steam, you
shot through to victory.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's no wonder you've thrown everyone into
an uproar.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I didn't mean to do anything special. It
didn't feel particularly fast to
me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I know all too well there are racers out
there who could've run faster.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You've caused quite a stir in the racing
world with your astounding
win, but you
still don't seem happy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I wonder when exactly that appetite of
yours will be sated.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I suggest you use the back entrance to the
dorms. There aren't any
reporters on that
side.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You've found yourself a good team—your
wins are proof of that. I'll
be watching
what you do next.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
When will my appetite be sated? You
should know that better than
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It'll be the day I beat you.
